task.title: 诊断: Troubleshoot failed startup and unreachable probes
task.shortdesc: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Diagnose a source-run BPM process that does not start or does not answer health and readiness probes.

prereq.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Use this procedure when make dev, uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000, GET /health, or GET /health/ready fails during source deployment or integration startup.

context.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 This diagnostic keeps process, environment, and probe evidence separate. It does not create a systemd unit, Windows service, reverse proxy, TLS endpoint, or production restart policy.

step.cmd: 诊断 1: Capture the failing command and foreground log.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Run or copy the exact command, then record stdout and stderr from the foreground terminal. Include make dev, uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000, Python traceback summary, working directory, and source revision from git rev-parse --short HEAD.

step.cmd: 诊断 2: Verify the configured host and port before changing code.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Check BPM_HOST, BPM_PORT, BPM_RELOAD, BPM_DATABASE_URL, and BPM_DOCUMENTATION_SITE_DIR. Focused rerun: curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health and curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health/ready.

step.cmd: 诊断 3: Separate process startup from probe reachability.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 If the process is not running, fix dependency, environment, or migration evidence first. If the process is running but probes are unreachable, check local firewall, bind address, WSL port forwarding, and whether the request targets 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0, or a Windows host route.

step.cmd: 诊断 4: Preserve user data while collecting evidence.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Copy logs, environment names, and probe responses only. Do not edit generated artifacts, database rows, schema cache files, or source code as routine recovery. Do not delete data/bpm.db to make startup pass.

step.cmd: 诊断 5: Choose the smallest rerun and escalation path.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Focused rerun: make test-fast for product smoke, make docs-validate only if documentation output is involved, and make test-docs-contract only for documentation contracts.
info.note: If probes remain unreachable after configuration and process checks, stop automated integration runs and escalate with command, logs, config names, and probe evidence.

result.p: 操作员获得分类诊断，保护 user data，并知道下一个 smallest rerun。 The operator can distinguish a failed process, an unreachable probe, and a deployment boundary without mutating user data.

postreq.p: 修复后返回相关 Administrator/DevOps workflow，只重跑受影响的 checks。 After probes pass, return to the health-gated startup or reusable API examples topic before running mutating integrations.
